EN: Maybe Coach got hungry and is hiding out in the old cereal processing plant. Rackie Jobinson's Jersey, here we come!
ZH: 也许教练饿了，然后躲在了某个麦片加工厂。罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫，我们来了！

EN: Sliding into Home
ZH: 溜回家

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: A wise choice! Take your reward, my loyal subjects!
ZH: 明智的选择！拿走你的奖赏吧，我忠诚的臣民！

EN: Fine, then! If not the water of life then the BLOOD OF DEATH! HAVE AT THEE!
ZH: 好、好吧！既不是生命之水，那就是死亡之血！放马过来！

EN: You have found me, the mighty Wizard of Water! The Deacon of Drink! The Titan of Thirst!
ZH: 你找到了我，强大的水之术士！饮料之神！水中泰坦！

EN: Think you can best me in armed combat? I think not! My pure, refreshing water will shield me!
ZH: 你认为你能在武装战斗中打败我吗？恐怕不可能。我纯净清新的水将会掩护我！

EN: But it doesn't need to come to that... Spare yourself my wrath and we can split the profits!
ZH: 但它不需要到那步……别生气，我们可以平分利润！

EN: What say ye, knaves?
ZH: 你们有什么话要说，无赖们？

EN: Settle down, Wiz. We don't want to fight. We just want our cut.
ZH: 冷静点，术士老大。我们不想打架，我们只要我们应得的那一份。

EN: You took advantage of too many people. You're going down, “Wizard”!
ZH: 你利用了太多的人。你必死了，“术士”！

EN: We've finally pinned down the Wizard of Water. Time to confront him and stop him from selling any more of his glorified tap water.  Maybe we can make some money on the side as well...
ZH: 我们终于抓住了水之术士。是时候面对他了，阻止他再出售他的虚假神水。也许我们还可以赚一笔……

EN: Snake Water
ZH: 蛇水

EN: Shut down the Water Wizard's operation.
ZH: 关闭水之术士的操作。

EN: Shut down the Water Wizard's operation.
ZH: 关闭水之术士的操作。

EN: I am Mr. Snip Snip! I have discovered some corn! Please, allow me to accompany and it is all yours!
ZH: 我是咔嚓先生！我发现了一些玉米！请允许我与您同行，我会把它们全给您！

EN: Who uh, what are you?
ZH: 你是谁？

EN: OH! Salutations! How serendipitous.
ZH: 哦！你好！真巧啊。

EN: I thought I would be alone forever!
ZH: 我以为我会永远孤单一人！

EN: Ma June has asked you to head to the nearby Super Duper Mart for supplies. Keep an eye open. You never know who or what you might run into there.
ZH: 玛·琼让你去附近的大无敌超市采购物资。注意周围，你永远不知道会遇到谁或什么危险。

EN: Snipping Coupons
ZH: 剪优惠券

EN: Search the Super Duper Mart.
ZH: 搜索大无敌超市。

EN: Search the Super Duper Mart.
ZH: 搜索大无敌超市。

EN: No Jersey, but limitless adventure. Am I right?
ZH: 没有棒球衫，只有无穷无尽的探险。我说的对吗？

EN: We're off to search the tenth location for Rackie Jobinson's Jersey. We may get lucky this time... right?
ZH: 我们出发去寻找第十个棒球衫可能存在的地点。这次我们应该会走运的……对吗？

EN: Somewhere in the Ballpark
ZH: 球场的某个地方

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Beats me. We sent our best tracker, Shadow Wolf, to follow their tunnels back to their source. He headed north, left an hour ago.
ZH: 我不知道。我们派了最好的追踪者，影狼，顺着它们的地道去找源头。他向北走了，走了一个小时了。

EN: So you're here about these trained Mole rats? Craziest thing I ever seen.
ZH: 所以你来这里是为了那些训练过的鼹鼠吗？真是太疯狂了。

EN: We set up traps over the Tato plants. Big spears that slam into the ground at the slightest vibration.
ZH: 我们在红果植株上布好了陷阱。只要有丝毫颤动，长矛就会飞射下来，直插入土。

EN: Caught us some Mole rats. Fat ones. With little packs full of Tatos. They were stealing them from under the ground!
ZH: 我们抓到了几只肥硕的鼹鼠。它们驮着一袋袋的红果。是它们从地下偷走了我们的粮食！

EN: How do you train Mole rats to do anything?
ZH: 怎么训练鼹鼠做这些呢？

EN: It turns out that this isn't a disease - someone has figured out how to steal Tatos from underground! We need to meet with the group that's figured it out.
ZH: 最后发现这个不是疾病——是有些人找到了从地下偷红果的方法！我们需要和这些人见个面。

EN: Spear Fishing
ZH: 用长矛钓鱼

EN: Meet the first farmers to lose their crops.
ZH: 去见见第一批丢失作物的农夫。

EN: Meet up with the first Tato farmers to lose their Tatos.
ZH: 去见见第一批丢失红果的果农。

EN: Yeah, sure you do. When this is over, you'll recognize your betters!
ZH: 是啊，随你们怎么说。等比赛结束，你们就会明白你们比谁差了。

EN: Simple minds are always so quick to violence...
ZH: 头脑太简单的人总是喜欢诉诸暴力……

EN: Look, simpletons in their natural habitat!
ZH: 看，傻子找到了他们的家！

EN: Do you even know the difference between a stalactite and a stalagmite?
ZH: 你们真的知道钟乳石和石笋的区别吗？

EN: We'll be Spelun-Kings, so you might as well concede now. That means “give up.”
ZH: 我们猜是洞穴探险的王者，所以你们最好还是退下吧。也就是说，你们“放弃吧”。

EN: Caves are damp and pointy rocks are pointy. We know enough to win.
ZH: 洞穴很潮湿，岩石很尖锐。我们知道的东西足够获胜了。

EN: Stalag-*this*, eggheads! That means, “Let's fight.”
ZH: 书呆子，要不要尝试下这个的滋味？我想说，“我们打一架吧”。

EN: These caves didn't stand a chance!
ZH: 这些洞穴根本就不在话下！

EN: The Overseer is sure to send us to the Spelun-King competition now.
ZH: 监督者已经确定要送我们去参加洞穴探险大赛。

EN: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send strong and perceptive Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
ZH: 一年一度的洞穴探险赛即将开始，但是该送哪一个居民过去呢？让我们派遣那些强壮又观察力敏锐的居民去吧，看看他们有多厉害！

EN: Do strong and perceptive Dwellers have what it takes?
ZH: 强壮又观察力敏锐的居民真的有本事赢得大赛吗？

EN: Okay, who forgot the Stealth Boys?
ZH: 好吧，谁忘了隐形小子了？

EN: Defend the clan!
ZH: 为部落而战！

EN: We thought you were a herd of brahmin. A slow, noisy herd of brahmin.
ZH: 我们还以为你们是一群双头牛呢。一群又慢又吵的双头牛。

EN: Swift and silent, we'll become Spelun-Kings without a scratch.
ZH: 快速又安静，我们会不动声色地成为洞穴探险的王者。

EN: Handypeople, vanish!
ZH: 巧手者，消失吧！

EN: We can still see you...
ZH: 我们还是能看到你们……

EN: We'll just have to scratch you wannabe ninjas here and now.
ZH: 那我们就只好现在就挠挠你们这些想当忍者的家伙了。

EN: And *that* is how you spelunk.
ZH: 所以，“那样”才是真正的洞穴探险。

EN: The Overseer is sure to send us to the Spelun-King competition now!
ZH: 监督者已经确定要送我们去参加洞穴探险大赛！

EN: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send charming and perceptive Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
ZH: 一年一度的洞穴探险赛即将开始，但是该送哪一个居民过去呢？让我们派遣那些有魅力又观察力敏锐的居民去吧，看看他们有多厉害！

EN: Do charming and perceptive Dwellers have what it takes?
ZH: 有魅力又观察力敏锐的居民真的有本事赢得大赛吗？

EN: So we're being watched right now? Interesting...
ZH: 所以现在我们被监视了吗？有意思……

EN: Fight to the death? How predictable.
ZH: 往死里打？真是意料之中。

EN: Dwellers can't beat a team of former Overseers.
ZH: 居民们怎么可能打得过由一群前监督者组成的队伍呢？

EN: We know how you think. We can see your every move. We control you!
ZH: 我们知道你们是怎么想的。我们能预见你们的每一步。我们控制着你们！

EN: Now take your proper places and bring us the Spelun-King crown!
ZH: 现在，守好你们的本分，赶紧给我们把洞穴大赛的皇冠拿过来！

EN: Nice try, but an Overseer already controls our every move.
ZH: 呵呵，挺会唬人的嘛，不过已经有一个监督者控制着我们的一举一动了。

EN: Our Overseer wants us to kill you.
ZH: 我们的监督者想杀了你。

EN: Spelunking is a piece of cake!
ZH: 洞穴探险对我来说小菜一碟！

EN: The Overseer is sure to send us to the Spelun-King competition now.
ZH: 监督者已经确定要送我们去参加洞穴探险大赛。

EN: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send tough and lucky Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
ZH: 一年一度的洞穴探险赛即将开始，但是该送哪一个居民过去呢？让我们派遣那些强悍又幸运的居民去吧，看看他们有多厉害！

EN: Do tough and lucky Dwellers have what it takes?
ZH: 强悍又幸运的居民真的有本事赢得大赛吗？

EN: You just deserve to win, and we'll watch your back until you do.
ZH: 那个胜利是你们应得的。在你们拿下它之前我们会一直关注着你的。

EN: Are you sure we can't just talk this over?
ZH: 你确定我们不需要讨论一下这个吗？

EN: The Spelun-King battlefied requires tact and charm against your opponents.
ZH: 在洞穴探险大赛的战场上需要有超越对手的机智和魅力。

EN: Which you seem to have in abundance.
ZH: 你看上去似乎完美拥有了这些。

EN: There's no hope for us. You're bound to be the next Spelun-Kings.
ZH: 对我们来说一点希望都没有。你们注定是下一个洞穴探险之王。

EN: Thanks! Such good sportsmanship is rare.
ZH: 谢谢！这样好的运动员精神已经很少见了。

EN: I see what you did there. It's time to shut you up.
ZH: 我知道你做了什么。现在该闭嘴了。

EN: That's how champions do it!
ZH: 冠军就是这么做的！

EN: The Overseer is sure to send us to the Spelun-King competition now.
ZH: 监督者已经确定要送我们去参加洞穴探险大赛。

EN: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send tough and smart Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
ZH: 一年一度的洞穴探险赛即将开始，但是该送哪一个居民过去呢？让我们派遣那些强悍又聪明的居民去吧，看看他们有多厉害！

EN: Do tough and smart Dwellers have what it takes?
ZH: 强悍又聪明的居民真的有本事赢得大赛吗？

EN: Ha! I think you need a longer look at our amazing muscles.
ZH: 哈！我想你们需要仔细看看我们这些完美的肌肉。

EN: Ha! Have you seen our swords?
ZH: 哈！你们有见过我们的剑吗？

EN: Puny weaklings! Have you seen our muscles?
ZH: 太弱了！你们有见过我们的肌肉吗？

EN: Look at these pecs, tris and glutes! Aren't they glorious? You can't compete with that.
ZH: 看看这些胸肌，肱三头肌和臀肌！是不是很耀眼？你们肯定赢不了。

EN: Spelun-King victory is already ours. Because muscles.
ZH: 洞穴探险大赛的胜利已经是我们的了。因为肌肉。

EN: It'll take much more than brute strength to win!
ZH: 要赢的话恐怕有蛮力远远不够吧！

EN: Your muscles can't be allowed to make it to the competition.
ZH: 就你们这种肌肉根本没有参赛资格。

EN: We came, we saw, we spelunked.
ZH: 我们来，我们看，我们探索洞穴。

EN: The Overseer is sure to send us to the Spelun-King competition now!
ZH: 监督者已经确定要送我们去参加洞穴探险大赛！

EN: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send charming and agile Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
ZH: 一年一度的洞穴探险赛即将开始，但是该送哪一个居民过去呢？让我们派遣那些有魅力又敏捷的居民去吧，看看他们有多厉害！

EN: Do charming and agile Dwellers have what it takes?
ZH: 魅力又敏捷的居民真的有本事赢得大赛吗？

EN: Then let the chips fall where they may!
ZH: 那就让该发生的都发生吧！

EN: All bets are off! Get them!
ZH: 规矩不算了！给我拿下他们！

EN: With us in the game, the deck is stacked against you!
ZH: 只要我们参加比赛，你们就不可能赢的！

EN: You're starting behind the eight ball against pocket aces.
ZH: 你们一开局就落在下风，而我们手里捏着一对王牌。

EN: We'll be Spelun-Kings. You can bet on it.
ZH: 我们将会成为洞穴探险之王的。你们尽可以打赌！

EN: No dice! The Vault always wins.
ZH: 不可能！避难所才是最后的赢家。

EN: Not if we stop you and your unbearable expressions right now.
ZH: 除非我们现在就阻止你和你那令人难以忍受的言论。

EN: Can't stop us, won't stop us!
ZH: 你不可能阻止我们的，也不会阻止我们！

EN: The Overseer is sure to send us to the Spelun-King competition now!
ZH: 监督者已经确定要送我们去参加洞穴探险大赛！

EN: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send strong and smart Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
ZH: 一年一度的洞穴探险赛即将开始，但是该送哪一个居民过去呢？让我们派遣那些强壮又聪明的居民去吧，看看他们有多厉害！

EN: Do strong and smart Dwellers have what it takes?
ZH: 强壮又聪明的居民真的有本事赢得大赛吗？

EN: (Sounds satisfied.)
ZH: （听起来很满意。）

EN: (Sounds confused.)
ZH: （听起来很困惑。）

EN: (Speaks in a muffled, unintelligible voice.)
ZH: （声音听起来低沉又含混不清。）

EN: (Continues to speak. Sounds arrogant.)
ZH: （继续说着什么。听起来很傲慢。）

EN: (Doesn't seem to realize he can't be understood through the mask.)
ZH: （并没有意识到他戴着面具说话，别人根本不明白。）

EN: Uh... Okay. Whatever you say.
ZH: 呃……好吧。随便你怎么说。

EN: No one insults us and lives!
ZH: 没有人侮辱了我们还能活着的！

EN: Nothing can stand in our way!
ZH: 没有什么能阻止我们！

EN: The Overseer is sure to send us to the Spelun-King competition now.
ZH: 监督者已经确定要送我们去参加洞穴探险大赛。

EN: The annual Spelun-King competition is coming up, but which Dwellers should go? Let's send lucky and agile Dwellers to explore a cave and see how well they do!
ZH: 一年一度的洞穴探险赛即将开始，但是该送哪一个居民过去呢？让我们派遣那些幸运又敏捷的居民去吧，看看他们有多厉害！

EN: Do lucky and agile Dwellers have what it takes?
ZH: 幸运又敏捷的居民真的有本事赢得大赛吗？

EN: Spelun-King Training
ZH: 洞穴探索训练

EN: Explore the cave.
ZH: 探索洞穴。

EN: Meet the other Spelun-King competitors.
ZH: 和其他洞穴探险竞争者见面。

EN: Ah! Unbelievers! We've got an even quicker way for you to meet Atom!
ZH: 啊啊啊啊啊！你们这些没有信仰的人！我们有一个更快的方法能让你们遇见原子！

EN: You can't stop us, we're on a mission from Atom!
ZH: 你们不能阻止我们，我们正在执行原子给我们的任务！

EN: Welcome, weary travelers.
ZH: 欢迎，疲惫的旅行者。

EN: Have you come to wash yourself in Atom's Glow?
ZH: 你是来在原子的光辉之下净身的吗？

EN: Just come a little closer...
ZH: 稍微靠近一点……

EN: Stay away, you freak!
ZH: 滚开，你们这些怪胎！

EN: No thanks, we're here to politely ask you to stop spraying people.
ZH: 不，谢谢，我们在这里礼貌地要求你停止喷人。

EN: Fine. We only did this to save the daylight, but we'll find other, less intrusive ways.
ZH: 好的。我们这样做只是为了节省天光，但我们会找到其他不那么有侵略性的方法。

EN: Well, who will save the daylight, if not us? Though I guess we can do that without involving Settlers...
ZH: 如果不是我们，谁来拯救天光？虽然我想我们可以做到这一点，且不打扰定居者们……

EN: Please, I beg you, let us put an end to all this violence.
ZH: 求你了，让我们结束这一切暴力。

EN: Atom seems to smile on you, and we must acknowledge this.
ZH: 原子似乎对你微笑，我们必须承认。

EN: Also, you have us out-gunned.
ZH: 而且，你们明显武器更多。

EN: I am Confessor Alvarado. What do you want from us?
ZH: 我是忏悔者阿尔瓦拉多。你想从我们这里得到什么？

EN: Our Overseer wants you to stop spraying people at random.
ZH: 我们的监督者想让你停止随意喷人。

EN: Give me one good reason not to shoot you...
ZH: 给我一个不开枪的理由……

EN: Our investigation has indicated that a local chapter of the Church of the Children of Atom was responsible for the recent toxic spraying attacks. We have to confront their leader, Confessor Alvarado, and tell him to stop these attacks, or else.
ZH: 我们的调查表明，最近这些毒物喷洒袭击是原子之子教会当地分会所为。我们必须当面质问他们的领袖忏悔者阿尔瓦拉多，让他停止这些攻击，否则就别怪我们不客气。

EN: Spring Forward, Fall Back
ZH: 春天向前，秋天向后

EN: Talk to Confessor Alvarado.
ZH: 和忏悔者阿尔瓦拉多交谈。

EN: Confront the local Children of Atom leader.
ZH: 和原子之子领袖对峙。

EN: Rejoice, E-Ster is coming!
ZH: 欢呼吧，E-斯特要来了！

EN: “And every eye shall be blind with his glory!”
ZH: “每只眼睛都会因他的荣耀而失明！”

EN: Surrender yourselves to Atom!
ZH: 臣服于原子！

EN: Roaming the Wasteland, unfortunately. For now, you can help us find Power Armor down here.
ZH: 不幸的是，漫游在废土上。现在，你可以帮助我们找到动力装甲在哪里。

EN: A true believer would already know, heathen!
ZH: 真正的信徒已经知道了，你是异教徒！

EN: Harm?! How dare you insult Pestilence, you heretic!
ZH: 伤害？！你怎么敢侮辱“瘟疫”，你们这些异教徒！

EN: That works! And it's even true. He's always covered in bits of earth. Thank you!
ZH: 有用的！甚至是真的。他总是满身是土。谢谢您！

EN: Welcome! Are you here for the blessing of Pestilence, or to join the Pests?
ZH: 欢迎！你是为了得到“瘟疫”的庇佑，还是加入“害虫”？

EN: To be a Pest is to be unworthy of his radiation, so we serve in other ways.
ZH: 作为一个“害虫”是不配他的辐射的，所以我们在其他方面服务。

EN: “Woe is me, woe is me, for I am unworthy. But Pestilence is great, all glowing and...”
ZH: 我是悲哀的，悲哀是我，因为我不配。但“瘟疫”是伟大的，散发圣光和……

EN: That's all I have for now. So, how can we help you?
ZH: 这就是我现在所拥有的。那么，我们如何帮助你呢？

EN: The blessing would be nice. Where is Pestilence?
ZH: 庇佑将是美好的。瘟疫在哪里？

EN: “Glowing”? What is Pestilence, exactly?
ZH: “发光”？到底什么是“瘟疫”？

EN: Pestilence's blessing is radiation? Doesn't that harm his followers?
ZH: 瘟疫的庇佑是辐射？这难道不是伤害他的追随者吗？

EN: What about “all glowing and earthy”?
ZH: “散发圣光和尘土”如何？

EN: So no one can avoid Pestilence's blessing, of course! But a real follower would know that...
ZH: 所以没有人可以避免瘟疫的庇佑，当然！但真正的追随者会知道……

EN: You there! Are you new converts?
ZH: 你在那里！你是新的皈依者吗？

EN: I hope the Pests down here didn't give you too much trouble.
ZH: 我希望这里的“害虫”不会给你带来太多的麻烦。

EN: They're all former Raiders, so they can be overzealous when meeting new people.
ZH: 他们之前都是掠夺者，所以遇到新人的时候可能会过分激动。

EN: Unfortunately, we haven't found any sign of the Power Armor. You?
ZH: 不幸的是，我们没有发现任何动力装甲的迹象。你呢？

EN: No luck either. Remind me, why are we looking for these suits?
ZH: 运气不好。提醒我，我们为什么要找这些装备？

EN: Cult logic, I guess. Just don't try telling them Pestilence's “blessing” would kill them.
ZH: 我猜是邪教的逻辑。只是不要告诉他们瘟疫的“庇佑”会杀死他们。

EN: No, I don't know why but it leaves the Pests alone while they're in fully enclosed outfits.
ZH: 不，我也不知道为什么，但只要它们穿着完全封闭的装备，那兽就不会去招惹“害虫”。

EN: Nothing. As far as I can tell, it's just a regular beast. Beats me why they worship it.
ZH: 没有什么。据我所知，这只是一只普通的野兽。我不知道为什么他们崇拜它。

EN: You're preaching to the choir, but they aren't exactly the sharpest tools in the shed.
ZH: 你在对牛弹琴，而且他们可算不上聪明。

EN: Oh good, you're not Pests! I'm an undercover reporter with the Weekly Exposition.
ZH: 哦，好吧，你不是“害虫”！我是一名每周博览会的卧底记者。

EN: We have people undercover with the three active Horsemen. No word yet on Death, if there is one.
ZH: 我们在三位活跃的“骑士”左右都安插了卧底。至于“死亡”，还没有任何消息，如果有的话。

EN: You have to tell my editor what I've found. Pestilence isn't a person like War!
ZH: 你必须告诉我的编辑我找到了什么。“瘟疫”不是和“战争”一样的人！

EN: It's a Glowing Radscorpion! And the suits all the Pests wear protect them from its radiation.
ZH: 这是一只发光辐射蝎！那些“害虫”穿着的防护服能让他们免受它的辐射。

EN: So what's all this talk about being unworthy?
ZH: 那么这些关于不配的话题是什么呢？

EN: But doesn't Pestilence attack them?
ZH: 但是“瘟疫”不会攻击他们吗？

EN: What makes this Glowing Radscorpion so special?
ZH: 是什么让这只发光辐射蝎这么特别？

EN: Why call themselves Pests? The Unworthy would have been much better.
ZH: 为什么称自己为“害虫”？“不配者”感觉是个更好的名字。

EN: At Three Dog's advice, we spread the word that a dozen suits of Power Armor were hidden in a particular cave. The Pests took the bait and are currently inside, searching for the suits. It's time to head in there and find out what we can about Pestilence and the Pests!
ZH: 在三狗的建议下，我们散播一个谣言，说有十几个动力装甲藏在某个洞穴里。“害虫”上钩了，目前正在里面搜寻洞穴。是时候去调查一下“瘟疫”和“害虫”了！

EN: Springing the Trap
ZH: 布置陷阱

EN: Discover Pestilence's identity.
ZH: 发现瘟疫的身份。

EN: Talk to the first group of Pests.
ZH: 与第一批害虫交谈。

EN: Talk to the second group of Pests.
ZH: 与第二组害虫交谈。

EN: Get answers from the Pests lured into your trap.
ZH: 从被引诱进陷阱的害虫口中得到答案。

EN: Blessed be the irradiated!
ZH: 愿辐射保佑我们！

EN: We are unworthy!
ZH: 我们不配！

EN: Accept Pestilence's radiation into your hearts!
ZH: 让“瘟疫”的辐射照进你们心中！

EN: Springtime for Atom
ZH: 原子的春天
